labels.reason: The quotation says the y, z ranges give the same guard distribution at every choice of spectator coordinates, which is only the independence-from-spectators part. It does not state that each guard value has probability 1/2^(K-1), nor that a guard is bad with probability 20/2^(K-1), and gives no reason (K-1 bits of y, remaining bits free).
